name: Adi ibn Zayd al-Ibadi
bio: Adi grew up among the Christians of al-Hira and knew both Arabic and Persian. He served at the Sasanian court as a secretary and interpreter, and al-Zirikli records a mission to the Byzantine emperor on behalf of Hormizd. He married Hind, daughter of al-Nu'man ibn al-Mundhir. His enemies turned the king against him, and he was killed in prison at al-Hira. Al-Zirikli dates his death to around 590 CE.
